text_block_list.text:
Alright! Open your eyes wide and watch this!!
Woooooaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Phew, that's how you get it nice and fluffy!
Now, the key point when shouting is—

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, is shouting seriously mandatory...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Of course it is!! Fighting spirit is essential!
Come on, City, let your voice roar from the bottom of your gut!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Special omelet training! City's gonna appear on a cooking show!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And when I mentioned it to senpai, she said, "I'll help you out!"...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: And that's what's so passionate! The reason City's taking on cooking, which she's terrible at!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah! You don't really have to tell them that—

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: "Seeing City always give her all in both modeling and racing gives me courage"—she wants to answer the calls of fans who say that!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: She accepted the TV offer specifically to show herself tackling cooking, despite being awful at it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...It wouldn't feel right if I only ever received their support. I get courage from my fans too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Guhhh!! So passionate! That's burning hot!!
City's heart is scorching hot...!!
I'm gonna support you with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: We can't just stand around! Wait right here for me!!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wait, senpai, did you seriously go do your usual thing...!?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
You bet! I took a plunge under the waterfall!
To cheer City on, I powered myself up too!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now, behold my newly evolved omelet skills...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaahhh!!!
choice_data_list: (!! She threw the egg and the frying pan into the air...!?)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now burn this into your memory! This is my Infinite [Infinity]!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Woooooaaaaahhh!!
choice_data_list: (I can see it... the boundless cosmos...!)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Alright, all done!
choice_data_list: —Wait, it's just a completely normal omelet!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Now then, I shall bestow this cooking technique I created upon City!!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Where do I even begin calling you out on this?
choice_data_list: Did the importance of never giving up get across...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Where do I even begin calling you out on this?
choice_data_list: Did the importance of never giving up get across...?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Well, yeah.
All I can do is keep trying until I can do it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I'll stick with you all the way!!
I'd like to ask the Trainer here to help out with taste testing, dishwashing, and all sorts of things too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, Bamboo Memory appointed me as the official taste tester, dishwasher, and egg procurer, pulling me into the fiery coaching session.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: No, why are you matching senpai's crazy energy...?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Uoooooh! It's getting hot in here!
Almost smells burnt—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (ROAAAAAARRRR...)

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaah~!!
I left the frying pan unattended!
